Climate: High humidity, abundant rainfall and steady temperatures
Crime Rate: Low (homicide rates have declined significantly in the past decade)
Work Life Balance: Varies by employer and industry; urban centers tend to have a faster pace.
Main Cities: Georgetown, Penang, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Ipoh
Main Industries: Electronics Manufacturing, Automotive Manufacturing, Service Sector, Oil and Gas, Palm Oil Production
Largest Companies: Maybank, Tenaga Nasional, Tenaga Del, PBBank (Public Bank Bhd), IHH Healthcare
Interesting Fact: The Strait of Malacca has been the site of many treasure shipwrecks.
Work Permit: Relatively easy to obtain, especially in key sectors (e.g., tech, education, manufacturing).
Top Universities: Universiti Malaya, Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia, Universiti Putra Malaysia, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia and Universiti Sains Malaysia.
Cultural Values: Respect for elders, family, and community, as well as a strong sense of culture.
People description: Malaysian people are typically known for their friendly and welcoming nature, reflecting the diverse multi-ethnic society where different cultures seamlessly blend together.
